label: sec:archimedean-condition-intro
html: The Euler characteristic \chi(\Sigma_g) = 2 - 2g of the spatial base curve is not a free parameter: requiring simultaneous compatibility of the three-colour tube decomposition, a non-vanishing Reeb flow, and one-dimensional Calabi–Yau descent uniquely selects g = 4 and \chi(\Sigma_4) = -6. This section states the Descartes condition \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0) = -6, traces the descent chain from the spectral curve to the zero-dimensional base locus, and proves that g = 4 is the maximal genus supporting an unobstructed descent tower.
